🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 10/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: very strong sector breadth but pronounced megacap divergence (multiple large caps showing 1W up vs 1M down or 1W down vs 1M up), and leadership is broad across sectors rather than concentrated — maintain neutral positioning.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Utilities lead: CEG (1W: +10.94% | 1M: +12.05%) ABOVE TREND, XEL (sentiment catalyst) showing strength. Materials strong: FCX (1W: +9.29% | 1M: +8.76%) ABOVE TREND. Consumer Staples steady: MNST (1W: +5.70% | 1M: +6.45%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Industrials lag: DE (1W: -6.43% | 1M: +19.31%) CORRECTION, LMT (1W: -3.73% | 1M: +7.85%) CORRECTION. Technology soft overall despite pockets of strength: NVDA (1W: -1.60% | 1M: -1.93%) BELOW TREND, ACN (1W: -3.52% | 1M: -24.81%) BELOW TREND.

📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: CEG (1W: +10.94% | 1M: +12.05%) ABOVE TREND; NFLX (1W: +9.86% | 1M: -1.16%) RECOVERY; FCX (1W: +9.29% | 1M: +8.76%) ABOVE TREND; PYPL (1W: +9.11% | 1M: -17.98%) RECOVERY; CRM (1W: +7.65% | 1M: -12.72%) RECOVERY. Leadership: Broad (5 sectors in Top 5).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: DE (1W: -6.43% | 1M: +19.31%) CORRECTION; IBM (1W: -5.57% | 1M: -17.17%) BELOW TREND; LOW (1W: -4.96% | 1M: -3.49%) BELOW TREND; GILD (1W: -4.86% | 1M: +1.99%) CORRECTION; ORCL (1W: -3.98% | 1M: -14.06%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in select tech and some large-cap industrials.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Best 1W movers: CEG (1W: +10.94%), NFLX (1W: +9.86%), FCX (1W: +9.29%). Note MAJOR divergence among megacaps — MSFT (1W: +0.82% | 1M: -16.22%) RECOVERY, GOOGL (1W: +1.50% | 1M: -8.12%) RECOVERY, META (1W: +1.90% | 1M: -2.37%) RECOVERY — tactical moves, not broad confirmation.

🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed / rotational. AAPL (1W: +4.75% | 1M: +5.78%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: -1.60% | 1M: -1.93%) BELOW TREND, CRM (1W: +7.65% | 1M: -12.72%) RECOVERY — many large tech names show short-term bounces against weaker 1M, sector breadth positive but internals uneven.

8. Financials Outlook?
Neutral-to-constructive rotation into pockets. PYPL (1W: +9.11% | 1M: -17.98%) RECOVERY, JPM (1W: -0.62% | 1M: +1.94%) CORRECTION, MA (1W: -1.06% | 1M: -1.08%) BELOW TREND — breadth positive but mixed between banks and payments.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Stable but cautious. PFE (1W: +0.89% | 1M: +2.26%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: -0.87% | 1M: +9.06%) CORRECTION, LLY (1W: -0.12% | 1M: -1.52%) BELOW TREND — defensive elements present while select names show profit-taking.

🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor rotation into broad, confirmed leaders across cyclicals and defensive pockets while maintaining neutral overall exposure; favor FCX (1W: +9.29% | 1M: +8.76%) ABOVE TREND and CEG (1W: +10.94% | 1M: +12.05%) ABOVE TREND, reduce exposure to structurally weak large-cap techs showing persistent 1M weakness.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: FCX (1W: +9.29% | 1M: +8.76%) ABOVE TREND — strong operational catalyst; NFLX (1W: +9.86% | 1M: -1.16%) RECOVERY — watch follow-through. BEARISH: NVDA (1W: -1.60% | 1M: -1.93%) BELOW TREND — soft guidance headlines; MSFT (1W: +0.82% | 1M: -16.22%) RECOVERY — monitor for failed follow-through.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Utilities (10 stocks, 1W: +2.58%) — energy/utility catalysts; Materials (11 stocks, 1W: +0.30%) — FCX strength. BEARISH: Industrials (15 stocks, 1W: -0.61%) — several names in CORRECTION; Technology (24 stocks, 1W: +0.39% | 1M: -8.16%) — mixed internals.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
NVDA (1W: -1.60% | 1M: -1.93%) — watch prior 1M support for trend confirmation; AAPL (1W: +4.75% | 1M: +5.78%) — test of recent breakout continuation; FCX (1W: +9.29% | 1M: +8.76%) — follow-through above last resistance confirms momentum.

📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
FCX (+65): Freeport secures extended Grasberg rights — FCX (1W: +9.29% | 1M: +8.76%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed by price. NUE (+75): buyback/cfo shift cited as positive (timeframe in dataset not shown here) — monitor for confirmation. MDT (+70): portfolio reshuffle/approval catalyst (timeframe in dataset not shown here) — watch for price follow-through.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
NVDA (-50): Q4 beat/guidance disappointed — NVDA (1W: -1.60% | 1M: -1.93%) BELOW TREND, sentiment confirmed. JNJ (-60): new talc verdict headline — JNJ (1W: -0.87% | 1M: +9.06%) CORRECTION, price shows partial resilience but risk remains. HD (-50): CEO comments on consumer weakness — HD (1W: -0.92% | 1M: -1.39%) BELOW TREND, sentiment confirmed.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with mixed style; sector breadth strong but megacap divergence keeps the market in balance. FCX (1W: +9.29% | 1M: +8.76%) ABOVE TREND and CEG (1W: +10.94% | 1M: +12.05%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: MAJOR divergence among megacaps (MSFT, GOOGL, META, AMZN vs NVDA) and several CORRECTION signals — watch for trend breaks and news-driven distribution.
